en: 1 m in the game = … real metres
ref: 1 m dans le jeu = … m réels
back_translation: 1 meter in the game = … real meters.

en: Ctrl + click on the map: move the area there.
ref: Ctrl + clic sur la carte : déplacer la zone ici.
translation: Ctrl + clic sulla mappa: sposta la zona qui.
back_translation: Ctrl + click on the map: move the area here.

en: Forests, fields, rock and marshes from ESA WorldCover
ref: Forêts, cultures, roches et marais d'après ESA WorldCover
translation: Foreste, campi, rocce e zone umide basati sui dati di ESA WorldCover
back_translation: Forests, fields, rocks, and wetlands, based on data from ESA WorldCover.

en: Result ready: you can export it as it is (tab 3) or adjust the advanced options.
ref: Résultat prêt : vous pouvez exporter directement (onglet 3) ou ajuster les options avancées.
translation: Risultato pronto: puoi esportarlo così com'è (scheda 3) oppure modificare le opzioni avanzate.
back_translation: Ready result: you can export it as it is (page 3) or modify the advanced options.

en: Game heights = real heights × this factor (empty = 1/√scale)
ref: Hauteurs du jeu = hauteurs réelles × ce facteur (vide = 1/√échelle)
translation: Altezza del gioco = altezza reale × questo fattore (valore predefinito = 1/√scala)
back_translation: Height of the game = real height × this factor (default value = 1/√scale).

en: Real altitude that becomes the game's water level (empty = auto)
ref: Altitude réelle qui devient le niveau de l'eau du jeu (vide = auto)
translation: Altitudine reale che determina il livello dell'acqua nel gioco (vuoto = automatico)
back_translation: Real altitude that determines the water level in the game (empty = automatic).

ref: Efface les bosses (arbres, bruit) ; 0 = relief brut
translation: Rimuove le irregolarità (alberi, rumore); 0 = rilievo grezzo

en: Metres taken off forests measured by Copernicus (tree tops)
ref: Mètres retirés aux forêts mesurées par Copernicus (dessus des arbres)
translation: Metri sottratti alle aree boschive misurate da Copernicus (cime degli alberi)
back_translation: Meters subtracted from the forested areas measured by Copernicus (tops of trees).

en: Everywhere, sources and joins included (the game's rivers: 110–165 m)
ref: Partout, sources et raccords compris (rivières du jeu : 110–165 m)
translation: Ovunque, comprese sorgenti e confluenze (i fiumi del gioco: 110–165 m)
back_translation: Everywhere, including sources and confluences (the rivers of the game: 110–165 meters).

en: Depth of the riverbed (the game's rivers: about 8.5 m)
ref: Profondeur du lit (rivières du jeu : ~8,5 m)
translation: Profondità del letto del fiume (nei fiumi del gioco: circa 8,5 m)
back_translation: Depth of the riverbed (in the rivers of the game: approximately 8.5 meters).

en: Shallowest sea past the shore slope; the real sea floor only makes it deeper
ref: Profondeur minimale de la mer après la pente du rivage ; les fonds marins réels ne font qu'approfondir
translation: Profondità minima del mare oltre la pendenza della costa; il fondale marino reale rende la profondità maggiore
back_translation: Minimum depth of the sea beyond the slope of the coast; the actual seabed determines a greater depth.
Minimum surface area of the lakes (hectares).

en: Smaller bodies of water are filled in, except on a river
ref: Plans d'eau plus petits comblés, sauf sur une rivière
translation: Le acque meno profonde vengono riempite, ad eccezione di un fiume
back_translation: The shallower waters are filled, with the exception of a river.

en: A river closer than this to other water is joined to it by a channel
ref: Une rivière à moins de cette distance d'une autre eau y est reliée par un chenal
translation: Un fiume che si trova a una distanza inferiore a questa da altre acque è collegato ad esse tramite un canale
back_translation: A river that is located at a distance less than this from other bodies of water is connected to them through a channel.

en: Every river ends in water or at the edge of the map
ref: Chaque rivière finit dans l'eau ou au bord de la carte
translation: Ogni fiume sfocia nell'acqua o sul bordo della mappa
back_translation: Each river flows into water or onto the edge of the map.
Connect the ends of the rivers (m).

en: Ends joined to nearby water in a straight line
ref: Extrémités reliées en ligne droite à l'eau proche
translation: Estremità collegate all'acqua vicina con una linea retta
back_translation: Ends connected to the water, near by, with a straight line.

ref: Les sources s'élargissent sur cette longueur
translation: Le sorgenti si allargano su questa distanza
back_translation: The sources widen over this distance.

en: Slope of the valley dug around a high river
ref: Pente de la vallée creusée autour d'une rivière haute
translation: Pendenza della valle scavata attorno a un fiume
back_translation: Slope of the valley excavated around a river.

translation: Pendenza delle sponde di mari e laghi
back_translation: Slope of the shores of seas and lakes.

en: Metres of depth gained per metre from the shore
ref: Mètres de profondeur gagnés par mètre depuis le rivage
translation: Metri di profondità aggiuntivi ogni metro dalla costa
back_translation: Additional meters of depth for every meter from the coast.

en: A lake with no river higher than this above the water level stays land
ref: Un lac sans rivière plus haut que ça au-dessus du niveau de l'eau reste en terre
translation: Un lago senza emissari, situato a un'altitudine superiore a questa rispetto al livello dell'acqua, rimarrà terra
back_translation: A lake without outlets, situated at an altitude higher than the water level, will remain land.
Map of tests of the rivers.

en: The game puts up to about {n} towns on a map of this size (guide)
ref: Le jeu met jusqu'à ~{n} villes sur une carte de cette taille (indicatif)
translation: Il gioco può includere fino a circa {n} cittadine su una mappa di queste dimensioni (indicazione)
back_translation: The game can include up to approximately {n} cities on a map of this size (indication).

en: More than the game's ~{n} towns for this size.
ref: Plus que les ~{n} villes du jeu pour cette taille.
translation: Più delle ~{n} cittadine presenti nel gioco per questa dimensione.
back_translation: More than the [number] female characters present in the game for this dimension.

en: In-game capacity of a town of 10,000 inhabitants
ref: Capacité en jeu d'une ville de 10 000 habitants
translation: Capacità di una cittadina di 10.000 abitanti nel gioco
back_translation: Capacity of a town with 10,000 inhabitants in the game.

en: 1 = in proportion to the population, 0 = all the same
ref: 1 = proportionnel à la population, 0 = toutes pareilles
back_translation: 1 = proportional to the population, 0 = all are equal.

en: The same economy as the map's climate in the Map Editor
ref: Même économie que le climat de la carte dans l'éditeur
translation: Stessa economia del clima della mappa nell'editor di mappe
back_translation: Same climate data for the map in the map editor.

en: 0 = the game's count for this density ({n}), with at least one base resource of every chain (the total may then be higher)
ref: 0 = nombre du jeu pour cette densité ({n}), avec au moins une ressource de base de chaque chaîne (le total peut alors dépasser)
translation: 0 = il numero di elementi che il gioco assegna a questa densità ({n}), con almeno una risorsa di base per ogni categoria (il totale potrebbe quindi essere superiore)
back_translation: 0 = the number of elements that the game assigns to this density ({n}), with at least one basic resource for each category (therefore, the total could be higher).

en: Roads chosen automatically: each town is linked to 1 or 2 others; the game lays the roads and links the industries to them. Right-click the map to add or delete a link.
ref: Routes choisies automatiquement : chaque ville est reliée à 1 ou 2 autres ; le jeu trace les routes et y raccorde les industries. Clic droit sur la carte pour ajouter ou supprimer une liaison.
translation: Strade selezionate automaticamente: ogni cittadina è collegata a 1 o 2 altre; il gioco crea le strade e vi collega le industrie. Clicca con il tasto destro sulla mappa per aggiungere o eliminare un collegamento.
back_translation: Automatically selected roads: each town is connected to 1 or 2 other towns; the game creates the roads and connects the industries. Click with the right mouse button on the map to add or delete a connection.

en: Roads changed by hand: no road between towns is added automatically any more.
ref: Routes modifiées à la main : plus aucune route n'est ajoutée automatiquement entre les villes.
translation: Strade modificate manualmente: nessuna strada verrà più aggiunta automaticamente tra le cittadine.
back_translation: Manually modified roads: no road will be automatically added between towns anymore.

en: Go back to the automatic choice of roads between towns
ref: Revenir au choix automatique des routes entre les villes
translation: Torna all'impostazione automatica delle strade tra le cittadine
back_translation: Return to the automatic setting for roads between towns.

en: The roads you added, deleted or kept will be lost. Continue?
ref: Les routes que tu as ajoutées, supprimées ou gardées seront perdues. Continuer ?
translation: Le strade che hai aggiunto, eliminato o mantenuto andranno perse. Vuoi continuare?
back_translation: The roads that you have added, deleted, or kept will be lost. Do you want to continue?

en: Yes, back to the default roads
ref: Oui, revenir aux routes par défaut

en: Tightest curve (the game allows 55 m; 300 m ≈ 90 km/h)
ref: Courbe la plus serrée (le jeu accepte 55 m ; 300 m ≈ 90 km/h)
translation: Curva più stretta (il gioco ammette curve di 55 m; 300 m ≈ 90 km/h)
back_translation: Tighter curve (the game allows for curves of 55 meters; 300 meters ≈ 90 km/h).

en: Steepest real gradient; steeper in the game when heights are shrunk less than distances (the game allows 8.5%)
ref: Pente réelle la plus forte ; plus raide dans le jeu quand les hauteurs sont moins réduites que les distances (le jeu accepte 8,5 %)
translation: Pendenza reale massima; più ripida nel gioco quando le altezze vengono ridotte meno delle distanze (il gioco ammette una pendenza massima dell'8,5%)
back_translation: Maximum actual slope; steeper in the game when the heights are reduced less than the distances (the game allows a maximum slope of 8.5%).

en: Distance kept from a town centre, plus half its capacity
ref: Distance gardée au centre d'une ville, plus la moitié de sa capacité
translation: Distanza mantenuta dal centro di una cittadina, più la metà della sua capacità
back_translation: Distance maintained from the center of a town, plus half of its capacity.

en: How far the line may leave the real one to suit the game's relief: along a bank rather than across the river, on the valley floor rather than on a bridge. 0: the real line.
ref: Jusqu'où la voie peut s'écarter du tracé réel pour suivre le relief du jeu : le long d'une berge plutôt qu'en traversant la rivière, en fond de vallée plutôt qu'en pont. 0 : tracé réel.
translation: Quanto può discostarsi la linea dal tracciato reale per adattarsi al rilievo del gioco: lungo una sponda anziché attraversare il fiume, sul fondo della valle anziché su un ponte. 0: il tracciato reale.
back_translation: How much can the line deviate from the actual route in order to adapt to the terrain of the game: along a bank instead of crossing the river, at the bottom of the valley instead of on a bridge. 0: the actual route.

en: {towns} towns · {industries} industries · {links} road links · {rails} railway line(s)
translation: {towns} cittadine · {industries} industrie · {links} collegamenti stradali · {rails} linea ferroviaria
back_translation: {towns} towns · {industries} industries · {links} road connections · {rails} railway line.

en: Right-click on the map: add an industry, a road or a railway line.
ref: Clic droit sur la carte : ajouter une industrie, une route ou une voie ferrée.
translation: Clicca con il tasto destro sulla mappa: aggiungi un'industria, una strada o una linea ferroviaria.
back_translation: Click with the right mouse button on the map: add an industry, a road, or a railway line.

translation: Versione del gioco {build}: più recente rispetto a quelle con cui RealMap è stato testato ({tested}). Se la generazione fallisce, controlla se è disponibile un aggiornamento di RealMap oppure invia il registro del gioco.
back_translation: Version of the game {build}: more recent than the versions with which RealMap was tested ({tested}). If the generation fails, check if an update of RealMap is available, or send the game log.

ref: Version du jeu {build} : plus ancienne que celles avec lesquelles RealMap a été testé ({tested}). Si la génération échoue, mets le jeu à jour.

back_translation: Version of the game {build}: older than the versions with which RealMap has been tested ({tested}). If the generation fails, update the game.

back_translation: Road connection planned (the game creates the road).

ref: Demande envoyée au jeu : génération dans l'éditeur de cartes…
translation: Richiesta inviata al gioco: generazione in corso nell'editor di mappe…
back_translation: Request sent to the game: generation in progress within the map editor…

en: Map “{name}” generated in the game. Save it in the Map Editor.
ref: Carte « {name} » générée dans le jeu. Enregistre-la dans l'éditeur.
translation: La mappa "{name}" è stata generata nel gioco. Salvala nell'editor di mappe.
back_translation: The map "{name}" was generated within the game. Save it in the map editor.

en: The game does not answer: the RealMap mod gives no sign of life in {dir}. Start Transport Fever 3, open the Map Editor on a new empty map “{size}” with the RealMap mod (up to date) enabled, then generate again.
ref: Le jeu ne répond pas : le mod RealMap ne donne aucun signe de vie dans {dir}. Lance Transport Fever 3, ouvre l'éditeur de cartes sur une nouvelle carte vide « {size} » avec le mod RealMap (à jour) activé, puis génère à nouveau.
translation: Il gioco non risponde: la mod RealMap non dà alcun segnale di attività in {dir}. Avvia Transport Fever 3, apri l'editor di mappe su una nuova mappa vuota "{size}" con la mod RealMap (aggiornata) attivata, quindi genera di nuovo.
back_translation: The game is not responding: the RealMap mod does not show any sign of activity in {dir}. Start Transport Fever 3, open the map editor on a new, empty map "{size}" with the RealMap mod (updated) enabled, and then generate it again.

en: The game does not answer here, but the RealMap mod is running in another game folder: {dir}. Choose that folder in the Export tab, then generate again.
ref: Le jeu ne répond pas ici, mais le mod RealMap tourne dans un autre dossier du jeu : {dir}. Choisis ce dossier dans l'onglet Export, puis génère à nouveau.
translation: Il gioco non risponde qui, ma la mod RealMap è in esecuzione in un'altra cartella del gioco: {dir}. Scegli quella cartella nella scheda Esporta, quindi genera di nuovo.
back_translation: The game is not responding here, but the RealMap mod is running in another folder of the game: {dir}. Choose that folder in the "Export" tab, and then generate it again.

en: The game does not answer: the RealMap mod is running, but the game is not in the Map Editor. Open the Map Editor on a new empty map “{size}”, then generate again.
ref: Le jeu ne répond pas : le mod RealMap tourne, mais le jeu n'est pas dans l'éditeur de cartes. Ouvre l'éditeur de cartes sur une nouvelle carte vide « {size} », puis génère à nouveau.
translation: Il gioco non risponde: la mod RealMap è in esecuzione, ma il gioco non è nell'editor di mappe. Apri l'editor di mappe su una nuova mappa vuota "{size}", quindi genera di nuovo.
back_translation: The game is not responding: the RealMap mod is running, but the game is not in the map editor. Open the map editor on a new, empty map "{size}", and then generate it again.

en: The game is still generating another map: wait until it is finished, then generate again.
ref: Le jeu génère encore une autre carte : attends qu'elle soit terminée, puis génère à nouveau.
translation: Il gioco sta ancora creando un'altra mappa: aspetta che sia completata, poi prova a generarla di nuovo.
back_translation: The game is still creating another map: wait for it to be completed, then try to generate it again.

en: The game does not answer: the RealMap mod in the game is version {mod}, the app version {app}. Update the mod (Mod Hub or the release's mod zip), restart the game, then generate again.
ref: Le jeu ne répond pas : le mod RealMap du jeu est en version {mod}, l'application en version {app}. Mets le mod à jour (Mod Hub ou zip du mod de la release), redémarre le jeu, puis génère à nouveau.
translation: Il gioco non risponde: la mod RealMap all'interno del gioco è in versione {mod}, mentre l'applicazione è in versione {app}. Aggiorna la mod (tramite il Mod Hub o scaricando il file zip della mod dalla versione più recente), riavvia il gioco e poi genera di nuovo.
back_translation: The game is not responding: the RealMap mod within the game is in version {mod}, while the application is in version {app}. Update the mod (through the Mod Hub or by downloading the mod's zip file from the latest version), restart the game, and then generate it again.

en: The game does not answer: the RealMap mod is running in the Map Editor but did not take the request. Please send the game's log to the author: {log} (rewritten at each game start, send it before restarting).
ref: Le jeu ne répond pas : le mod RealMap tourne dans l'éditeur de cartes mais n'a pas pris la demande. Envoie le journal du jeu à l'auteur : {log} (réécrit à chaque lancement du jeu, envoie-le avant de relancer).
translation: Il gioco non risponde: la mod RealMap è in esecuzione nell'editor di mappe, ma non ha elaborato la richiesta. Per favore, invia il registro del gioco all'autore: {log} (viene riscritto ad ogni avvio del gioco, invialo prima di riavviare).
back_translation: The game is not responding: the RealMap mod is running in the map editor, but it has not processed the request. Please send the game log to the author: {log} (it is rewritten with each game start, send it before restarting).

en: The game was not ready yet: request sent again.
ref: Le jeu n'était pas encore prêt : demande renvoyée.
translation: Il gioco non era ancora pronto: la richiesta è stata inviata di nuovo.
back_translation: The game was not yet ready: the request was sent again.

en: No news from the game for 5 minutes (generation stuck?).
ref: Le jeu ne donne plus de nouvelles depuis 5 minutes (génération bloquée ?).
translation: Nessuna novità dal gioco da 5 minuti (generazione bloccata?).
back_translation: No news from the 5-minute game (generation blocked?).

en: Import Heightmap → Minimum {min}, Maximum {max}, Water Level 0.
ref: Import Heightmap → Minimum {min}, Maximum {max}, Water Level 0.
translation: Importa la mappa altimetrica → Minimo {min}, Massimo {max}, Livello dell'acqua 0.
back_translation: Import the altimetric map → Minimum {min}, Maximum {max}, Water level 0.

ref: Colonnes (ouest → est) : chenaux de {list} m de large.
translation: Colonne (da ovest a est): canali di {list} metri di larghezza.
back_translation: Columns (from west to east): channels of {list} meters of width.

translation: Righe (da nord a sud): {list} m di profondità.
back_translation: Rows (from north to south): {list} meters of depth.

en: Show the “Navigable Waters” layer and note the coloured channels.
ref: Affiche le calque « Navigable Waters » (eaux navigables) et note les chenaux colorés.
translation: Mostra il livello "Acque navigabili" e osserva i canali colorati.
back_translation: Show the "Navigable Waters" level and observe the colored channels.

en: A computation or a generation is running: installing closes the app and stops it. Install anyway?
ref: Un calcul ou une génération est en cours : l'installation ferme l'application et l'interrompt. Installer quand même ?
translation: Un calcolo o una generazione è in corso: l'installazione chiude l'applicazione e la interrompe. Vuoi comunque procedere con l'installazione?
back_translation: A calculation or a generation is in progress: the installation will close the application and interrupt it. Do you still want to proceed with the installation?

en: This install does not update itself: download the new installer from the release page.
ref: Cette installation ne se met pas à jour toute seule : télécharge le nouvel installeur sur la page de la version.
translation: Questa installazione non si aggiorna automaticamente: scarica il nuovo programma di installazione dalla pagina delle release.
back_translation: This installation does not update automatically: download the new installer from the releases page.

en: Portable version: download the new zip from the release page and replace RealMap.exe.
ref: Version portable : télécharge le nouveau zip sur la page de la version et remplace RealMap.exe.
translation: Versione portatile: scarica il nuovo file zip dalla pagina delle release e sostituisci il file RealMap.exe.
back_translation: Portable version: download the new zip file from the releases page and replace the RealMap.exe file.

en: The mod is updated separately: through the game's Mod Hub, or with the zip attached to each release.
ref: Le mod se met à jour à part : par le Mod Hub du jeu, ou avec le zip joint à chaque version.
translation: La mod viene aggiornata separatamente: tramite il Mod Hub del gioco, oppure tramite il file zip allegato a ogni versione.
back_translation: The mod is updated separately: either through the game's Mod Hub, or through the zip file attached to each version.

en: No public release found on GitHub (private repository?): cannot check.
ref: Aucune version publique trouvée sur GitHub (dépôt privé ?) : vérification impossible.
translation: Nessuna versione pubblica trovata su GitHub (repository privato?): impossibile verificare.
back_translation: No public version found on GitHub (private repository?): impossible to verify.

en: GitHub is limiting requests: try again in a few minutes.
ref: GitHub limite les requêtes : réessaie dans quelques minutes.
translation: GitHub sta limitando le richieste: riprova tra qualche minuto.
back_translation: GitHub is limiting the requests: please try again in a few minutes.

en: Invalid update signature: nothing was installed.
ref: Signature de la mise à jour invalide : rien n'a été installé.
translation: Firma dell'aggiornamento non valida: nulla è stato installato.
back_translation: Signature of the update is invalid: nothing has been installed.

en: To generate a map: open a new empty map of the right size in the Map Editor,
ref: Pour générer une carte : ouvre une nouvelle carte vide de la bonne taille dans l'éditeur de cartes,
translation: Per generare una mappa: apri una nuova mappa vuota, delle dimensioni corrette, nell'editor di mappe,
back_translation: To generate a map: open a new, empty map with the correct dimensions in the map editor.

en: then click “Generate the map” in the RealMap app. Everything is built here, automatically.
ref: puis clique sur « Générer la carte » dans l'application RealMap. Tout se construit ici, automatiquement.
translation: quindi, clicca su "Genera la mappa" nell'applicazione RealMap. Tutto viene creato qui, automaticamente.
back_translation: So, click on "Generate the map" in the RealMap application. Everything is created here, automatically.
Verification of the map is in progress…

en: Open the Map Editor: the map can only be generated in a new empty map of the Map Editor.
ref: Ouvre l'éditeur de cartes : la génération ne se fait que dans une nouvelle carte vide de l'éditeur.
translation: Apri l'editor di mappe: la mappa può essere generata solo in una nuova mappa vuota dell'editor di mappe.
back_translation: Open the map editor: the map can only be generated in a new, empty map within the map editor.

translation: Impossibile trovare il file della mappa (userdata/importcity/%s.lua).
back_translation: It is impossible to find the map file (userdata/importcity/%s.lua).

en: The open map is %d × %d tiles, %d × %d are needed (%s): create a new map of that size.
ref: La carte ouverte fait %d × %d tuiles, il en faut %d × %d (%s) : crée une nouvelle carte de cette taille.
translation: La mappa aperta è composta da %d × %d celle, ne servono %d × %d (%s): crea una nuova mappa di queste dimensioni.
back_translation: The open map is composed of %d x %d cells; it requires %d x %d (%s): create a new map of these dimensions.

en: The open map already has towns or industries: create a new empty map.
ref: La carte ouverte contient déjà des villes ou des industries : crée une nouvelle carte vide.
translation: La mappa aperta contiene già cittadine o industrie: crea una nuova mappa vuota.
back_translation: The open map already contains cities or industries: create a new, empty map.

translation: La mappa altimetrica "%s" non è stata trovata in userdata/heightmaps.
back_translation: The altimetric map "%s" was not found in userdata/heightmaps.

translation: I biomi "{%s}" non sono stati trovati in userdata/biomi.
back_translation: The biomes "{%s}" were not found in userdata/biomes.

en: No import generator for the climate of this map.
ref: Aucun générateur d'import pour le climat de cette carte.
translation: Nessun generatore di importazione disponibile per il clima di questa mappa.
back_translation: No import generator is available for the climate of this map.

en: the game refused to replace the terrain
ref: le jeu a refusé de remplacer le terrain
translation: Il gioco ha rifiutato di sostituire il terreno
back_translation: The game refused to replace the ground.

en: the game refused to create the towns
ref: le jeu a refusé de créer les villes
translation: Il gioco ha rifiutato di creare le cittadine
back_translation: The game refused to create the female characters.

en: Warning: the map's economy is “%s”, the industries were planned for “%s”.
ref: Attention : économie de la carte « %s », industries prévues pour « %s ».
translation: Attenzione: l'economia della mappa è "%s", le industrie previste sono per "%s".
back_translation: Attention: the economy of the map is "%s", and the expected industries are for "%s".

en: %d town(s) created, %d set to their real size.
ref: %d ville(s) créée(s), %d mise(s) à leur taille réelle.
translation: %d cittadine create, %d impostate alla loro dimensione reale.
back_translation: %d cities created, %d set to their real size.

en: %d / %d road segment(s) turned into simple dirt roads (2 lanes).
ref: %d / %d tronçon(s) de route transformé(s) en chemins de terre simples (2 voies).
translation: %d / %d tratto/i di strada trasformato/i in semplici strade sterrate (2 corsie).
back_translation: %d / %d section(s) of road transformed into simple dirt roads (2 lanes).

en: Map “%s” generated. Save it (Map Editor menu).
translation: Mappa "%s" generata. Salvala (nel menu dell'editor di mappe).
back_translation: Map "%s" generated. Save it (in the menu of the map editor).
